headline: LME Copper Extends Slide to Four-Month Low on AI Worries and Dollar
summary: Three-month copper on the London Metal Exchange fell 0.2% to $13,225 a metric ton, touching its lowest level since July. The metal faced pressure from cooling artificial intelligence enthusiasm, dollar strength, and soft economic indicators from China.
why: Copper is a vital industrial metal utilized across power grids, data centers, construction, and electronics, widely viewed as a leading indicator of global economic activity.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: A stronger dollar and tempered expectations for AI infrastructure metal consumption depressed prices.
